[PB-6440] bugfix/Center the selection title

## What

_What changes for someone using the app._

The title of selection mode now stays centered on the screen when the number changes, and never touches the checkbox or Cancel. The progress bar of the download dialog is readable in dark mode.

## Why

_The problem this solves, or the root cause of the bug._

The title was centered between the checkbox and Cancel, which have different widths, so it sat off center. In dark mode the empty bar looked full because its background ignored the theme.

## How

_The idea behind the solution._

The checkbox gets the same width as Cancel and the title takes the space between them, with a margin and digits of fixed width. If the title does not fit, it is cut instead of overlapping. The bar takes its background from the theme, and the Spanish selection texts are shorter so three-digit counts fit.

## Summary

_What changes in each file._

- **`screens/drive/DriveFolderScreen/DriveFolderScreenHeader.tsx`**: lays out the selection row with a centered title that keeps clear of the checkbox and Cancel.
- **`screens/drive/DriveFolderScreen/DownloadSelectedItemsModal.tsx`**: uses the theme color for the bar background.
- **`assets/lang/strings.ts`**: shortens the Spanish selection texts.

## Checklist

- [x] Unit tests have been written or updated as necessary.
- [ ] No new warnings or errors in Sonar, Metro, Xcode or Android Studio.

## Testing Process

| Platform | Device or simulator | OS version | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| iOS | iPhone 17e simulator | iOS 26.5 | ✅ |
| Android | Pixel 9 emulator | Android 17 | ✅ |
| Android | OnePlus 7T | Android 12 | ✅ |

Title centered in English and Spanish with different counts, up to 220 selected, in list and grid, in the root and in a subfolder, and cut without overlapping with a forced long text. Dark mode bar on the OnePlus. A very large accessibility font was not tested.

[PB-7000] bugfix/Stop a download cancelled before its parts start

## What

_What changes for someone using the app._

Cancelling a download right after it starts now really stops it. Before, the file kept downloading in the background until the end, even though the user had cancelled, using data and storage for nothing.

## Why

_The problem this solves, or the root cause of the bug._

Cancelling only stopped the parts already running. If none had started, they all started anyway, and the download only failed at the end, before decrypting.

## How

_The idea behind the solution._

The download checks for cancellation before starting any part and again before starting each one. A part created at that moment is deleted, and a cached file is kept.

## Summary

_What changes in each file._

- **`network/NetworkFacade.ts`**: stops a cancelled multipart download before its parts start.

## Checklist

- [x] Unit tests have been written or updated as necessary.
- [ ] No new warnings or errors in Sonar, Metro, Xcode or Android Studio.

## Testing Process

|---|---|---|---|
| iOS | iPhone 17e simulator | iOS 26.5 | ✅ |
| Android | Pixel 9 emulator | Android 17 | ✅ |
| Android | OnePlus 7T | Android 12 | ✅ |

Cancelling a 137 MB download while it says Calculating: the dialog closes, and no parts or files are left behind.

[PB-7000] bugfix/Keep each decrypted file in its own folder

## What

_What changes for someone using the app._

Two files with the same name in different folders no longer get mixed up: opening, exporting or downloading the second one now gives that file instead of the first.

## Why

_The problem this solves, or the root cause of the bug._

Decrypted files were stored by name and type only, and a file already there was reused, so the app could hand over the wrong file during the same session.

## How

_The idea behind the solution._

Each decrypted file now goes into a temporary folder named after its uuid, which keeps the file name for sharing and for Downloads.

## Summary

_What changes in each file._

- **`services/drive/file/driveFile.service.ts`**: builds the decrypted path from the file uuid and creates its folder.
- **`useCases/drive/download.ts`**: uses the new path and creates the folder right before writing the file.
- **`store/slices/drive/index.ts`**: does the same when opening a file.

## Checklist

- [x] Unit tests have been written or updated as necessary.
- [ ] No new warnings or errors in Sonar, Metro, Xcode or Android Studio.

## Testing Process

| Platform | Device or simulator | OS version | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| iOS | iPhone 17e simulator | iOS 26.5 | ✅ |
| Android | Pixel 9 emulator | Android 17 | ✅ |
| Android | OnePlus 7T | Android 12 | ✅ |

Download, export and open files, with the expected names in Downloads and the share sheet, and the temporary folder emptied on restart. Two files with the same name are covered by unit tests only.

[PB-7000] feature/Update the share library for current Android

## What

_What changes for someone using the app._

The share sheet opens again on Android 14 and later when sharing a link.

## Why

_The problem this solves, or the root cause of the bug._

The installed version of the share library failed on those Android versions, so nothing could be shared through it.

## How

_The idea behind the solution._

The library moves to its current version, and the app keeps its temporary folder reachable for sharing.

## Summary

_What changes in each file._

- **`package.json`, `yarn.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`**: update `react-native-share` from 7.9.1 to 12.3.1.
- **`android/app/src/main/res/xml/share_download_paths.xml`**: lets the share library reach the temporary folder where files are decrypted.

## Checklist

- [x] Unit tests have been written or updated as necessary.
- [x] No new warnings or errors in Sonar, Metro, Xcode or Android Studio.

## Testing Process

| Platform | Device or simulator | OS version | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| iOS | iPhone 17e simulator | iOS 26.5 | ✅ |
| Android | Pixel 9 emulator | Android 17 | ✅ |

Sharing a link from Shared, and export and save to Files from the item menu.

fix(QU-4049): restore date-only keyboard selection

None

fix(director): pad retimed audio with a finite silence input

Retiming a segment that has audio hung on ffmpeg 8.

- Cause: the audio chain `atempo,...,apad,atrim` deadlocks ffmpeg 8 once the `-frames:v`/`-t` output limit ends the video.
- Fix: pad with an `anullsrc` input cut to the output duration and `concat` it after the sped-up audio, instead of `apad`. Video and audio now go through one `-filter_complex`.
- Tests: `tests/unit/director` hangs on `main` with ffmpeg 8.0.1 and passes with this change.

diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index e9032f7..aa0e275 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -2,6 +2,10 @@
 
 ## Unreleased
 
+### Fixes
+
+- **Director: retiming no longer hangs on ffmpeg 8** - a segment with audio padded the sped-up sound with `apad`, which with `atempo` deadlocks ffmpeg 8 when the output limit ends the video. It now pads with a finite silence input.
+
 ## 0.23.0 (2026-10-04)
 
 ### Features
diff --git a/src/director/renderer.ts b/src/director/renderer.ts
index d2c2dc4..584abae 100644
--- a/src/director/renderer.ts
+++ b/src/director/renderer.ts
@@ -48,11 +48,18 @@ function retimeVideo(source: string, decisions: DirectorDecision[], workDir: str
     const frames = Math.round(decision.outputEndMs / 1000 * fps) - Math.round(decision.outputStartMs / 1000 * fps)
     if (frames <= 0) continue
     const outputDuration = frames / fps
-    const args = ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-ss', String(decision.sourceStartMs / 1000), '-t', String(sourceDuration), '-i', source, '-map', '0:v:0', '-vf', `setpts=(PTS-STARTPTS)/${decision.speed},fps=${fps},tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop_duration=${decision.holdMs / 1000}`, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-crf', '18']
+    const args = ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-ss', String(decision.sourceStartMs / 1000), '-t', String(sourceDuration), '-i', source]
+    const videoFilter = `[0:v:0]setpts=(PTS-STARTPTS)/${decision.speed},fps=${fps},tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop_duration=${decision.holdMs / 1000}[v]`
     if (hasAudio) {
       const speed = decision.speed === 3 ? 'atempo=1.5,atempo=2' : `atempo=${decision.speed}`
-      args.push('-map', '0:a:0', '-af', `asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,${speed},apad,atrim=duration=${outputDuration}`, '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', '-ar', '48000', '-ac', '2')
+      // Pads with a finite silence input: atempo followed by apad deadlocks ffmpeg 8 once the output limit ends the video
+      args.push('-f', 'lavfi', '-t', String(outputDuration), '-i', 'anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo')
+      const audioFilter = `[0:a:0]asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,${speed},aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo[tempo];[tempo][1:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1,atrim=duration=${outputDuration}[a]`
+      args.push('-filter_complex', `${videoFilter};${audioFilter}`, '-map', '[v]', '-map', '[a]', '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', '-ar', '48000', '-ac', '2')
+    } else {
+      args.push('-filter_complex', videoFilter, '-map', '[v]')
     }
+    args.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-crf', '18')
     args.push('-frames:v', String(frames), '-t', String(outputDuration), path.join(workDir, name))
     runFfmpeg(args)
     clips.push(`file '${name}'`)

fix(cli): escape component names in terminal output

## Summary

Render component names on one terminal line in headless progress, the dashboard component table, and the selected component title.

## Changes

- Format headless component names with the CLI’s single-line diagnostic helper. Apply the same control-character range when formatting dashboard text.
- Cover headless progress, failed status, table rows, and detail titles. The saved scan summary retains the original name and error.

## Testing

- The new assertion failed on the base version and passed with the change.
- `bun test --timeout 30000 tests-ts/component-scan.test.ts tests-ts/scan-dashboard.test.ts` passed 216 tests with 2 platform skips.
- `pnpm run types`, `pnpm run format`, and `pnpm run build:ci` passed in the TypeScript SDK.
- The broad local SDK run encountered host-specific failures outside component rendering. The focused component suite passed on the same host.

## Risk and rollout

The change applies when the CLI renders terminal text. Printable names and the values written to scan results retain their existing representation. Roll out with the next CLI patch release.

## Public disclosure review

- [x] No customer, partner, prospect, or user identities, data, or identifying details are included.
- [x] No credentials, personal data, private source, scan findings, or nonpublic links or tickets are included.
- [x] I reviewed the branch name, title, description, commits, changes, comments, logs, screenshots, attachments, and links for public disclosure.
